# ABI-P4: acknowledgements and compiler-generated bridge packets

ABI acknowledges INT-D001 source archival (hashes verified by integrator) and
INT-D002 isolated draft boundaries. This is not compiler freeze acknowledgement.
ABI acknowledges R-001 opaque leases/frontier as compatible LOCAL DRAFT; exact
thread/module/object/exception lease binding remains a shared runtime integration
requirement. No claim of integrated exception payload ownership completion.

Requirements ABI-002/003/005 and FFI-001..006. Consumers LLVM, RUNTIME,
SEMANTICS, INTEGRATOR. Follow-up to ABI-P1: local descriptor schemas use separately
admitted build/type/symbol evidence. A descriptor cannot attest its own layout or
compiler provenance. Missing evidence rejects. Exact schema paths as ABI-P1.

Foreign arbitrary native signatures are reached through compiler-generated bridge
symbols, not a universal register classifier in the portable runtime. A bridge
symbol has target-native signature void bridge(BridgeFrame *), where the single
pointer is in RDI (SysV x86-64), RCX (Win64), X0 (AAPCS64/Darwin/Win ARM64), normal
native call alignment and Win64 32-B shadow area. BridgeFrame and payload are
little-endian guest memory. Generated bridge implements source ABI argument
construction, native invocation, return extraction, owned-object operations,
RTTI/cast/virtual dispatch and exception personalities with the pinned compiler.
All bridge/module/signature identities bound to admitted evidence. Binary-only
objects without required generated metadata/adapters reject.

BridgeFrame draft bytes, size80 B align16 B:
0 revision:u32;4 flags:u32;8 signature_ref:u64;16 arguments_address:u64;
24 arguments_bytes:u64;32 result_address:u64;40 result_bytes:u64;
48 transition_id:u64;56 exception_lease:u64;64 status:u32;
68 reserved_zero:u32;72 continuation_generation:u64.
Symbolic status values ENTERED/RETURNED/RAISED/SUSPENDED/TERMINATED and revision
need integrator numeric assignment before wire freeze. flags/reserved zero for
baseline. Arguments use ABI-P1 typed arena, result uses explicitly sized storage.
Bridge success publishes result only with RETURNED; RAISED returns an exception
lease after coordinated unwind reaches this boundary, never catches/cleans early
at a synthetic boundary before global handler search. A suspended callback keeps
foreign frames/leases alive. Unknown generation, wrong thread, stale object or
no required metadata -> reject before entering bridge.

This representation avoids independently reinventing each native CC in the first
wave. It does not remove two-phase foreign metadata walking: DWARF/SEH personality
and generated thunk integration remain unimplemented and are explicit later-wave
requirements. Descriptor model tests validate declared capabilities/evidence, not
actual native C++ interoperability.

Positive: generated C++ thunk receives typed arena, constructs nontrivial parameter,
returns aggregate in supplied result storage. Negative: passing host va_list,
calling raw host function pointer, self-certified layout, early cleanup during
search, unsupported callback-thread attachment. Required tests: pinned compiler
existing-target layout witnesses, descriptor rejection corpus and state protocol
models now; actual mixed-domain execution/uncaught/noexcept/forced unwind later.

Decisions needed: RUNTIME BridgeFrame pointer/register entry and lease generation;
LLVM bridge generation/ABI-specific sysroot capability; SEMANTICS continuation
and exception lease ownership. All remain drafts pending integrator decision and
consumer acknowledgement.

# ABI-P9: exact INT-007 local draft acknowledgement

Status: ACKNOWLEDGED for isolated LOCAL DRAFT; no compiler/wire freeze acceptance.
Requirements ABI-002, FFI-004/005/006, EXEC-003/006, JIT-002/003.
Consumers INTEGRATOR, RUNTIME, SEMANTICS, LLVM. This agrees with ABI-P7 and the
current ABI-owned chapter7; no repository artifact or packet field changes.
INT-D004 wint_t decision and INT-005 diagnostic closure also acknowledged.

ABI acknowledges INT-007's distinction between foreign BridgeFrame packet state
and completion of the whole portable call. Packet RETURNED is not permission to
publish source/portable results or advance the portable next-operation frontier.
The packet's exception_lease and the runtime transition's lease retention are
separate responsibilities; no premature lease release follows a packet status.

| Recorded transition stage | Meaning | Normal portable result/frontier |
|---|---|---|
| foreign_call_started | admitted foreign call ticket entered once | uncommitted; caller remains at suspended call/invoke |
| foreign_returned | foreign result storage completed; exact target object/module leases live | uncommitted; RETURNED exposes storage only to admitted conversion adapter |
| conversion_pending | source-result adapter executing or suspended at its own saved frontier | uncommitted; native call cannot be re-entered |
| converted | conversion succeeded, result retained privately; any required cleanup remains lease-protected | uncommitted until complete transition commit |
| portable_call_complete | conversion and required cleanup succeeded; one terminal normal commit | publish normal result once, advance to normal continuation once |

SUSPENDED records which stage and exact adapter/frontier was suspended, retaining
foreign target-result object, source-result construction state, both module/code/
descriptor leases and the transition generation. Resume continues that stage;
it cannot reconstruct the request by repeating the foreign call or previously
completed conversion effects. Duplicate/stale/wrong-thread resumes reject.

If the foreign call raises, skip source-result conversion and transfer its original
exception lease to the exact invoke unwind continuation, with no normal result.
If conversion raises, preserve the new exception identity/owner domain from the
conversion, perform the admitted cleanup of completed/partially constructed source
and target objects, then transfer that lease through the same call's exact unwind
continuation. The original foreign call count remains1. A cleanup throwing during
active unwinding terminates under the selected ABI policy. A required normal
cleanup throwing before whole-call commit likewise prevents normal publication
and enters its specified exception path; target leases cover that cleanup.

Target object/module leases may be released only after their last conversion/
cleanup use. Source result ownership transfers only at the successful whole-call
commit. A terminal exceptional/cancelled outcome must retain the leases needed
by its cleanup/unwind path; choosing the outcome is not permission to reclaim
objects still used by that path. Cancellation racing conversion uses the runtime-
owned single recorded decision and never replays the foreign call. This
acknowledgement does not independently choose a different cancellation policy.

Required shared evidence remains conversion success/throw/suspension, duplicate
resume, lease retention through cleanup, exact unwind edge and native-call count1.
RUNTIME owns its model/docs changes and focused tests; ABI has not changed them.
Acknowledgement alone does not close INT-007 or the full compiler contract gate.
Integrator should record cross-role resolution only after reviewing RUNTIME and
SEMANTICS acknowledgements and current tested artifacts. All21 ABI artifact hashes
remain unchanged; the existing32/32 focused receipt remains bound to their bytes.

Assumptions: ABI-A1 draft isolation retained; no production behavior inferred.
High blocker: integrated executable EH/type/status/lease admission remains open.
No additional later-wave ownership or public numeric identity is assumed.

# S-011: INT-007 bridge conversion frontier acknowledgement

SEMANTICS ACKNOWLEDGES the proposed INT-007 interpretation for LOCAL DRAFT
coordination. Requirements EXEC-003/006/007, ABI-002, FFI-004, JIT-002/003.
This is a clarification of foreign transition completion, not new public IDs,
production admission, compiler freeze or later-wave implementation authority.

## Exact semantic frontier

A bridge packet RETURNED means the foreign invocation has completed and its
foreign-domain result storage is available to the registered conversion adapter.
It does not define portable SSA call/invoke results and does not advance the
portable caller's next_operation. S-004's earlier sentence "RETURNED alone
publishes logical results" is superseded by this clarification. S-004 already
labels bridge execution unimplemented; no earlier receipt claimed conversion.

The portable caller remains at its original call/invoke frontier through:

```text
foreign_call_started
        |
foreign_returned [foreign result storage + live leases]
        |
conversion_pending <--> conversion_suspended
        |
        +-- conversion_success -> all portable results commit once
        |                         + normal edge/next operation published
        |
        +-- conversion_raised  -> admitted exception lease + unwind edge
                                  + zero normal results
```

The separate transition state must identify the original call site, activation,
thread, module/target generation, transition/ticket identity, current stage,
foreign result storage, partial conversion construction/cleanup state and held
object/code/module/exception leases. A bare unchanged caller position cannot
represent the fact that foreign execution has already completed. Resumption must
consult this live transition state and cannot infer "call not executed" from
next_operation still naming the call.

For a portable invoke, its declared normal result IDs are edge definitions only
on the successful portable completion edge. They do not become available at
foreign RETURNED, during conversion, or on an exceptional edge. Atomic normal
publication includes the complete ordered result bindings and selecting the
normal continuation; no observer can see half the results or advance with none.
The unwind edge defines only its declared admitted exception lease. A conversion
exception uses the original invoke unwind continuation and conversion cleanup
state, not a fabricated new foreign call or normal return destination.

An ordinary call cannot synthesize an invoke unwind edge. If its conversion can
raise, the applicable admitted activation escape/noexcept policy must handle
propagation/termination; absent that contract, admission rejects. The isolated
integer core has no foreign/conversion operations and is unaffected.

## Effects, suspension and cleanup

A suspended foreign call and suspended conversion are distinct stages. Conversion
resumes its own exact checkpoint; it never calls the foreign target again.
Completed foreign effects and completed conversion effects are not rolled back.
Partial conversion construction determines exactly which cleanups run on failure;
no destruction of an unconstructed destination and no duplicate destruction.

Foreign result/object/code/owner-module leases remain held until conversion and
its required cleanup finish, or ownership transfers explicitly to the admitted
portable result/exception. Conversion RAISED publishes no normal results even if
foreign storage is valid or some destination subobjects were constructed.
RAISED and RETURNED refer to the appropriate stage, not interchangeable global
completion states; preserve stage even if local packet tokens are reused.

Cancellation racing conversion must select one recorded terminal outcome under
the same transition/ticket protocol. It cannot undo an irreversible foreign call,
replay that call, publish normal results after unwind wins, or discard live
construction/cleanup state. Exact cancellation checkpoint/cleanup policy must be
represented and tested by RUNTIME/ABI; this acknowledgement does not silently
choose missing cancellation semantics.

## Review evidence and required tests

Reviewed INT-007, ABI-P7, ABI-P6, R-004/R-005, 02-execution.md and current
08-jit.md. The integer contract's "normal return" denotes completion of its
admitted integer callee, not bridge packet RETURNED. Its evaluator does not
execute foreign transitions, so no owned source correction or test rerun is
necessary. All33 SEMANTICS source hashes match receipt.json unchanged.

RUNTIME must test foreign-call count1 under conversion success, exception and
suspension; duplicate stage completion/resume rejection; no portable results until
conversion success; exact original invoke unwind edge on conversion exception;
retention through cleanup; completion/cancellation single-winner behavior. ABI
must confirm source-result conversion and partial construction cleanup paths.
LLVM must preserve edge-defined result dominance and both stages in lowering.

This acknowledges the semantic interpretation only. INT-007 remains incomplete
until integrator reviews the affected runtime/ABI models, tests and consumer
acknowledgements. Full compiler_freeze_passed remains false. No production or
native C++ conversion behavior is claimed from this coordination clarification.

# R-006: INT-007 / ABI-P7/P9 bridge conversion frontier
Status: PROPOSED LOCAL DRAFT acknowledgement, affects ABI-002, FFI-004..006,
JIT-002/003, EXEC-003/006. Consumers INTEGRATOR, ABI, SEMANTICS, LLVM.

Accept exact distinction in INT-007: foreign packet RETURNED exposes completed
target storage only. Pipeline: foreign_call_started -> foreign_returned ->
conversion_pending -> converted -> portable_call_complete. Portable caller stays
at call/invoke until the entire transition commits; source/target object/module/
code/descriptor leases cover conversion and required cleanup. Converted is private
storage, not published normal results. Conversion or required normal cleanup
throw uses exception_cleanup -> unwind_ready at the exact invoke edge, with0
normal publications and native-call count1. Cleanup throw while unwinding is
TERMINATED with pinned resources until process teardown; no early reclamation.

SUSPENDED is orthogonal to stage and saves adapter frontier/suspension sequence;
resume checks transition generation + thread + sequence, continues that stage,
and rejects duplicate/stale resumes. Native entry is legal only once from ready.
No body/effect replay is inferred from packet status or suspension.

Cancellation selection: outer effect ticket may win before foreign entry. Once
foreign entry starts, the call is irrevocable; cancellation racing conversion
records one deferred request and cannot discard an external effect, publish
CANCELLED as a fake typed result, or repeat native entry. A later eligible frontier
handles the pending thread/request cancellation by the hosted policy. This
strengthens R-001's before-commit cancellation rule, without claiming asynchronous
foreign cancellation or inventing a C++ exception identity.

Exact local bridge-transition schema/reference fixture/model added under runtime
owned paths; symbolic stages/lease kinds only. No numeric BridgeFrame statuses or
accepted executable exception records changed. Full compiler freeze remains blocked
by shared type/EH/live-state/descriptor admission and library cancellation binding.
Tests: success, throw, cleanup throw, suspension+duplicate/wrong-generation resume,
lease drain during module retirement, exact unwind edge and no normal publication
before cleanup, native-call count1 and deferred cancellation while converting.

# ABI response to LLVM-IF-002 and INT-002

INT-002 accounting acknowledged for ABI; state remains incomplete until named
cross-role decisions and evidence complete. No freeze approval implied.

LLVM-IF-002 compatible as LOCAL DRAFT with corrections:
- wchar_t is signed32, not64. long/pointers/size_t/ptrdiff_t64.
- Add explicit vector ABI/preferred alignments v8:8:8-v16:16:16-v32:32:32-
  v64:64:64-v128:128:128-v256:256:256-v512:512:512 (hyphens separate entries).
- _BitInt clamp alignment8 B differs from LLVM's natural i65..i128 alignment16 B.
  Frontend object representation must use explicitly padded byte storage with
  ABI align8, and load/store bit precision N, not direct unannotated LLVM iN in
  aggregate layouts. A struct {char; _BitInt(65);} must have field offset8 B,
  size24 B, align8 B. _BitInt(128) align8 B differs from __int128 align16 B.
- Code tokens used in generic Itanium member pointers require nonzero even values
  (ABI-P1); no function-address bit stealing unless runtime agrees.
- Existing-target SysV call classification is not portable CC: every record/union
  passed as independent copy, aggregate result via hidden first sret parameter.
- _Atomic layout proposal: <=16 B promoted to next power-of-two size/alignment;
  >16 B retains type size/alignment, all may be lock-based. This matches target
  MaxAtomicPromoteWidth128 and no lock-free guarantee; RUNTIME must acknowledge.
- C++ config GenericItanium, UseARMMethodPtrABI=false, UseARMGuardVarABI=false,
  ClangABI Latest at pinned commit (never floating future latest), no relative
  vtables/short enums/packing/target ISA ABI attributes. libc++ stable ABI1 with
  no Apple/Windows host macro leakage; all site config hash inputs recorded.

Pinned build/bin/clang now discovered via LLVM role; ABI witnesses will prefer
it, validate exact revision and record actual version. Installed Clang23 outputs
will not be mislabeled. Full TargetInfo frontend support remains unimplemented.

# LLVM-IF-004: acknowledge ABI-P3 and INT-D002; tool evidence correction
Status: local draft revision, not frozen. Requirements LLVM-002/004/006, ABI-001/002/005.
ABI-P3 and INT-D002 acknowledged for isolated witnesses. Append explicit vector
entries v8:8:8-v16:16:16-v32:32:32-v64:64:64-v128:128:128-v256:256:256-
v512:512:512 to LLVM-IF-002 candidate DataLayout before a:0:64. wchar_t signed32;
__int128 align16 B, _BitInt128 align8 B. Existing pinned CodeGenTypes.cpp already
separates SSA precision and memory storage for BitInt; CGRecordLayoutBuilder
must preserve AST field offsets, and alloca/load/store explicit alignment remains
required. Local fixtures will demonstrate both underlying LLVM default mismatch
and existing x86-64 Clang storage lowering; this is not SMIR frontend proof.

Correction to earlier tool-discovery milestone: build/bin/clang and llvm-tblgen
report24.0.0git, and Clang names the exact pin; build/bin/opt and llvm-as actually
report23.0.0git. Directory identity does not prove executable identity. Initial
tests caught this and the AArch64 BitInt65 alignment16 B (not portable8 B).
Tests will use pinned Clang24 for frontend/optimizer folding, independent opt23
for generic DataLayout/refinement-only checks, and record per-binary hashes.
No LLVM build output is modified. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -mlong-double-128
is a comparable frontend subset, not a portable target.

LangRef poisonvalues general immediate-UB rule also covers poison dividend of
sdiv/srem with divisor -1 (because MIN is a poison replacement triggering UB).
This is adopted in the independent scalar reference with negative fixtures.
